descriptions.text: The Ashley & Perrin Series Brave is an old school construction, a trait shared by all A&P weapons. It is a basic working carbine, without any extras. Good range, moderate damage potential and a reasonable rate of fire makes this weapon good value for money.
This is a Mentor Edition item, which originally only can be acquired from a successful mentorship period.

The Ashley & Perrin Series Freedom is a modified version of the Series Hero. Same trigger, and identical design but containing an advanced method of energy build up, making the delivered damage higher than the Series Hero model.

The Ashley & Perrin Series Hero is a carbine made for heavy-duty protection. A&P has marketed the Series Hero towards the settlers and colonists that venture out into the wilderness on Calypso. The weapon in itself is of a basic design, but a very reliable workhorse.
The King is a basic carbine used for self-defence. It is targeted towards the new colonists who need a  weapon that is somewhat cheap but reliable in the face of danger when defending their homes.

The A-3 Justifier Mk.I is a basic military assault carbine with an aggressive design. Its rate of fire is greater than most standard carbines, due to an effective heat dissipation device and a top-notch energy converter.

The assault carbine A-3 Justifier Mk.II was made by request of the Desert Rangers on Calypso. The weapons converter was exchanged, thus upping the damage potential – something that was necessary when the rangers met Calypsos larger predators.

A-3 Justifier Mk.III is the latest addition to the Affirmative Action Arms family of assault carbines. The trigger mechanism was exchanged for an even more rapid firing design, and the masterfully enhanced heat emitters work like a charm, making it capable of inflicting more damage in a shorter time.

The A-3 Justifier Mk.IV is a laser assault carbine made for various Force/Recon ops. Its range is somewhat shorter than other Justifier models, but its increased capacity energy transceiver makes the energy transference greater, helping to battle this shortcoming. This weapon is scare on Calypso, and is primarily used in full frontal assault operations, using Earth Shock Troopers.

The Mk.V from A-3 is a work of wonder. A-3 took the improved version of the Mk.II that the Desert Rangers had designed, and made a new standard weapon based on their findings. Speed over power was the goal, and this means that the Mk.V is a rapid-firing assault carbine, capable of mid-range offensive and defensive roles. This weapon is not imported to Calypso, but a few sources say that it can be found nevertheless.
This is a Mentor Edition item, which originally only can be acquired from a successful mentorship period.

Affirmative Action Arms are mostly known for their series of rapid-fire carbines, making the A-3 Punisher seem like the odd child in the A-3 family. The Punisher was made as an inexpensive civilian version of A-3’s more expensive military carbines in the Justifier family. The Punisher is a functional weapon, with moderate statistics and potential.

Affirmative Action Arms has recognized the need for more powerful civilian weapons and designed this modified version of their A-3 Punisher. It was distributed amongst selected civilians for extended field-testing but the results have still not been made official. Rumors has it that the expectations where set a little too high. Even so it’s said that this weapon is one step closer to match the more advanced military Justifier carbines, making the Punisher Mk.II a little more than just another functional weapon.

Many people have been drawn to the Series Heroes simple design and rugged mechanics. This has also attributed to several attempts to enhance this fine carbine further. The Calypso-born Yssete Riemeriu is one of those who did manage to get a company running on her adjustments. The weapon has seen several interesting innovations, including a better ventilation system, a faster generator and an inner casing of durable super-alloys.

The Mk.V is a rare  sighting on Calypso, as it almost always is smuggled to the colony. The mad hacker/tech-wiz Wulfer "Krankheit" Blau  adjusted a version of the weapon, using standard replacement parts out of the book. The design was spread and many applied  the ideas to the Mk.V`s available on the planet. The basic things exchanged were the trigger servo, the mirror  amplification emitter in the barrel and some excess weighty parts in the stock. After Blau vanished during an expedition in  the mountains south of Hadesheim, the designs were nowhere to be found - all public copies self-disintegrated.

Imperial Interface Major Rambaldi "Warthog" Inverness asked famed tinkerer Roman Ram to make modifications to the original Warthog design, to suit his need to higher reliability, effect, and destructive power. The adjusted model was so successful, and Major Inverness asked for large scale manufacturing for his entire one hundred men strong unit, "The screaming angels". Most of the weapons are still in unit possession, but a few have been dispersed following the death of individual squad members.

The adjusted Ravenger Mini-Sweeper V1 is equipped with better components that give it more firepower. The result is an increased overall efficiency that even exceeds its predecessor, the Mini-Sweeper V2, in all areas except for range.

The Welles & Adams Co. adjusted this weapon and made a truly marvelous job with it. They included additional heat sinks, thus managing to increase the damage caused by this weapon a great deal. Another bonus is that the materials used are a great deal better than the original, thus reducing the repairs to the weapon.

Even though the original Outbacko was designed for youngsters, it was still a little on the heavy side. Therefore a private company, known as Welles & Adams Co., made a version that was easier to use. The weight of this adjusted weapon has been reduced through the use of lighter materials in several key parts of the weapon. On the negative side, these new materials are not very good at limiting the heat build-up, thus making the rate of fire somewhat lesser compared with the original series.

The DOA Rockjacker is a  heavy-duty combat sweeper, used to clear rooms quickly of any hostiles. It was also used, with great success, by the now  eradicated crack unit Machine Smashers Bravo Three-Nil. The team got wasted during a nefarious robot ambush, lead by a unit  of fearful Stalker robots. Many of the Rockjackers on Calypso were lost in this battle.

The new high standard on the AS-117 gave weapon engineers the possibility to create this modified version that is truly lethal. It has given this binary liquid propellant assault rifle a great firing rate, a long range and a very efficient firing power.

The Zychion Duke and Imperial Commander Rahls Unbaraz wanted a series of  rifles to indicate his personal guards. The native designer Kox Katre, decorated war hero and appointed Licenced Imperal  Weapon Smith, took the task. He based the design on the combat-proven TR6, but made the weapon more robust with a core  bolt-carrier of valurite. The barrel was exchanged for a heavy precision counterpart and the internal cooling system was  enhanced threefold, allowing for a higher rate of fire. Finally, the weapon was applied with a special coat of  anti-corrosive paint in the Duke of Zychion`s colors of red, blue and black.

They use ordinary BLP packs, but launch several bullets per pull of the trigger, to create the classical shotgun pellet effect. The large bore of the weapon makes the range limited though. The Warthog was such a success in military circles that a special version of the shotgun was created, by the legendary Roman Ram.

The Q-D is a nice scratch-built project,  turned into real industry. The inventors used the well known Marber series of plasma guns, and exchanged several parts to  produce a better and moire efficient weapon. The intense heat from the plasma emission gives the weapon a slow recharge.

The Q-D 2 is an effort to make the  cooling process quicker - a much requested feature most plasma gun users demand. To achieve this, the damage output is  somewhat lower and the range is marginally less than the Model 1.

The Sollomate Aggressio is an effective hand-to-hand combat energy powerfist. The powerfist is a close combat weapon which is strapped to the users hand and wrist. The weapon utilizes an electrical energy matrix and a durable layer of omni-steel, making it tough and hard-hitting.
The Beauto is a competent carbine for sports hunting of medium sized creatures. Its  low upkeep costs works in its favor.

This carbine is the one approved for home protection by the Federal Empire, to be obtained through the Trade Terminals. Busho is great for practice but is not he preferred gun when venturing against tougher prey. One appealing factor is its low price tag.

Sollomate Kangoo is a more mature version of the Outbacko, if one listens to the marketing made by Sollomate. The truth is that the Kangoo is an energy-upgraded version that does inflict more damage, but also drains more energy.

The Opalo is an entry level laser carbine aimed for lesser skilled personnel. Its function is flawless with a smooth and easily-operated design. Against normal foes this carbine is an excellent choice.
Sollomate Outbacko is a carbine aimed at kids and such, as a genuine plinking rifle at the target range. The damage is limited, but it also uses little energy to fire.

Sollomate Tasmo looks similar to the other Sollomate carbines but is really quite different beneath. The converter, the accelerator and the compounds are all of high quality. The weapon is often used as a light hunter carbine, when prey like snabelsnots or fugabarbas are in sight.

The AS-129 was made as a shock trooper weapons for storming fortified encampments. This weapon`s strength is its tremendous rate of fire. Unfortunately, this also comes with a price, as its production quality and decay rate are all in the poor side. It is believed that some robots actually collect AS-129 as trophies over mankind’s futile attempts to bring down the machines.

The EWE EP-35 (Earth Weapon Enterprises Energy Pistol) is a heavy pistol which deals quite a lot of damage, at the expense of a somewhat long cooling off period.

The EWE EP-38 (Earth Weapon Enterprises Energy Pistol) is a powerful defense weapon aimed towards the colonists on Calypso. Range is limited as the power emitter is optimized towards wounding. The cooling system sometimes crashes, meaning a slow reload rate.

The EWE EP-40 (Earth Weapon Enterprises Energy Pistol) has several features that appeal to combat ready personnel. It has a high rate of fire, a powerful energy maximizer and an improved cooling system. Its only drawback is that this weapon also uses a lot of energy each time it is fired.

The EWE EP-41 (Earth Weapon Enterprises Energy Pistol) was designed to be the standard issue laser handgun for units of the Federal Imperial Forces, but eventually proved a bit too heavy. Some FIF army space divisions still use them as secondary weapons.
The EWE EP-43 (Earth Weapon Enterprises Energy Pistol) is a very competent handgun. It has a long range, a decent reload rate and packs a real punch.

The EWE EP-45 (Earth Weapon Enterprises Energy Pistol) is a massive piece of work, designed to be a potent backup pistol for any serious big game hunter on Calypso. Rugged design, reliable mechanics and electronics, and a thirsty power system are three distinctive features.

The EWE EP-50 (Earth Weapon Enterprises Energy Pistol) was made with one purpose only, and that was to supply special ops personnel with a sidearm efficient enough to kill an opposing creature or machine with only a few well placed shots. The result, the EP-50 Ranger, has a huge energy consumption, but the damage done is great. EP has had problems with cooling, and several of the handguns have faulty mechanics in that area.

The Plasma sniper was issued in small numbers to the crack insertion force known as the Crimson Devils. They were a rowdy bunch of ex-convicts given another chance in the Imperal Forces. They often worked in small teams on Amethera, striking against robots and other threats to the colonists during the war. Their methods were to strike with stealth – fast, hard and to disappear before the enemy got any bearing on their position. Most of the group was killed in a nuclear explosion at the Northern parts of Amethera, when a robot strike shuttle crashed onto their main campsite.

It's said to be specifically designed on demand from the assigned authorities on Calypso and used by special anti-robot rangers, but this has been strongly denied by both the company and political officials. The weapon has a long range and great firepower, but suffers somewhat from a low rate of fire and a fairly high cost in ammunition, just like the previous versions.

Meckel & Loch made a sniper version of their  versatile ML-series of battle rifles. The entire bolt section, BLP-mixing chambers and caliber was upgraded to allow for a  rapid mechanism allowing for tight accurate burst groups. The barrel was exchanged to a heavy version made out of precision  high grade xeremite/durulium alloys, drilled in zero-G. The result is an impressive Imperial Force/Recon Sniper rifle  capable of taking out a mutant with one shot - if the sharpshooter is good enough. The weapon`s fine precision mechanics do  however require a lot of maintenance to operate at peak performance.

After a debate, the constructor Remrick Era’Nolann felt that a fast, reliable hunting rifle was something the hunting public wanted. After a meeting with Fire Forge, Era’Nolann made a deal to produce a test run of a couple of hundred weapons, to be used on Calypso. The design, a light fast firing hunting rifle, did attract a few customers, but Fire Forge were not pleased, and therefore stopped production after the test run was completed. This also made sure that production quality was never improved, and unfortunately several weapons in the series are flawed in certain ways. Era’Nolann himself was very distraught by this, but began his search for a new weapon to modify.

Within the old Order of the Empire, two brothers proved themselves as prominent and devout followers of the faith. The brothers, Jacob and Ivian Kallous, of Mars heritage, always worked together and soon became the most well-known keepers of the secrets within the order. The Chapter Overlord was concerned when the reports of the robot assault on humanity on Calypso reached him, and set forth sending an elite cadre to destroy the abomination rising against its creator. Leading the cadre unit were the brothers. Just prior to departure they received a gift each - a finely crafted and meticulously prepared weapon, made by the wisest engineers within the Order Keep.Ivian, the larger of the two brothers, received the Legend War Axe, a mighty weapon that cleaved enemies like rye to the scythe. The axe seemed to glow with a life-like pulse when Ivian used in the combat to strike down the foes of mankind. Ivian and his team managed to kill some two thousand robots during the war, and it wasn't until late in the campaign that the robots seemed to acknowledge the power Ivian had in him, so they decided to trick him. The clever trap sprung as the team lead by the stalwart leader entered a bombed out outpost near Zychion Citadel. Once in the ruins, the robots attacked with a massive force, but when the machines concluded they would lose this battle to the giant of a man, they initiated the destruction of the power plant under the ruins - effectively disintegrating every living being several kilometers away. A Federal Search and Rescue party found the Legend War Axe in the ruins, apparently untouched by the massive destructive force from the blast.
